part.text:
All 7519 groupBy tests pass, including `GroupByQueryQueryToolChestTest.testCacheStrategy` which fails without the fix (it exercises a result-level cache round trip with two post-aggregators).

**The fix** (processing/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/query/groupby/GroupByQueryQueryToolChest.java:688): in `CacheStrategy.pullFromCache`, the loop that reads post-aggregator values from the result-level cache never incremented `postPos`, so every cached post-agg value was written into the first post-agg slot (last value wins) and the remaining slots were left as 0/null. Added the missing `postPos++`.

This explains the reported symptom exactly: with multiple post-aggs, the last cached post-agg value ended up in the first column (a2 = 31,548 = a1×3) and later ones were NULL, while zero or one post-agg worked fine.
